# Copilot instructions

- Use Java 25 when running builds or tests.
- Keep changes small and focused; do not modify unrelated files.
- Follow the existing package structure and Java style.
- Run relevant JUnit tests after Java behavior changes.
- Add or update tests when behavior changes or existing coverage is affected.
- Run manual UI tests only when explicitly requested.
- Add Javadoc for public APIs and non-obvious logic; omit it for trivial methods.
- Do not commit, tag, or push unless explicitly requested.
